description: Returns where a date falls in the Western church year: the season (Advent, Christmas, Epiphany, Lent, Holy Week, Easter, or the season after Pentecost, also called Ordinary Time), the week of the season, the day's observance and liturgical color, the church year and its lectionary year (A, B or C), and that year's Western Easter and Orthodox Pascha. Defaults to today in Mountain Time.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form, years 1583 to 4099. Defaults to today in Mountain Time.

name: season_for_date
title: Season for a date
